## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and organizing fresh ideas.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry whenever you have an idea.
2. Include the following fields:
   - **Title**
   - **Description**
   - **Category**
   - **Priority** (1-5)
   - **Status** (New, In Review, Approved, Rejected)
   - **Owner**
   - **Notes**
3. Review and update status regularly.

## Template
```
Title: 
Description: 
Category: 
Priority: 
Status: 
Owner: 
Notes: 
```

Feel free to adapt the template to your workflow."}

Notes: 
```

## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and organizing fresh ideas.

   - **Description**
   - **Category**

   - **Status** (New, In Review, Approved, Rejected)
   - **Owner**
   - **Notes**
3. Review and update status regularly.

Title: 
Description: 
Category: 
Priority: 
Status: 
Owner: 
Notes: 
```

Feel free to adapt the template to your workflow."}
